npmIntegrity: sha512 recorded by npm matches the packed tarball
localAgentLinks: Against https://crabrix.com with crabrix@0.5.0 from npm (npx -y crabrix@0.5.0 over stdio, official MCP client): a person created a room with the library; an agent joined through the website agent link (key in the path) and another through the app form (key after #); both wrote a file the person read, and each handed off only its own link in the same form.
remoteMCP: crabrix.com serves crabrix serve-http from the same tarball. A room created in the web Playground after its warning modal gave an agent link; the official MCP client connected to it as a Streamable HTTP server, read the room, wrote a file that appeared in the browser and was listed as Agent · Crabrix. The app form sent to the remote MCP returned 404 with the local-only message.
notRunForThisRelease: Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok clients themselves; the checks used the official MCP TypeScript client in their place. Runtime execution through a browser or the app, and the Rust and Go bindings against production. Their local suites passed.
